inputs.52.text: Modern flat-colour anime illustration in the style of a cute mobile-game mascot key visual: bold, clean dark outlines of even weight, bright flat cel colours filled edge to edge, one simple step of soft shading, crisp edges everywhere. One small film clapperboard, black slate with white chalk lines and a black-and-white striped clapstick, closed, seen straight on at a slight angle, centred on a plain, even pale off-white background with a little empty margin around it, even soft lighting, the object filling most of the frame.
